name: Pralsetinib
mechanism: Highly selective ATP-competitive RET inhibitor active against RET fusions and mutations.
keyToxicities: Musculoskeletal pain and creatine kinase elevation
interactions: Avoid strong CYP3A inhibitors and inducers and combined P-gp/CYP3A inhibitors.
resistance: RET solvent-front mutations and bypass signalling, similar to selpercatinib.
